files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Changed
- **Table header Select All checkbox, uniform column divider and heading alignment, and complete German translations** ([#206](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/issues/206)). Added a top-left `Select All` checkbox in the duplicate files table header that toggles selection of all deletable copies in the active duplicate group, added a vertical column divider before `Preview` matching the other columns, aligned all column headings (`Preview`, `Name & Path`, `Size`, `Status`, `Actions`) and cell contents consistently to the left of their dividers, and completed German (`de` and `de_DE`) translations for all table headings (`Größe`, `Aktionen`, `Name & Pfad`, `Vorschau`, `Status`) and recent UI strings in `l10n/de.json`, `l10n/de.js`, `l10n/de_DE.json`, and `l10n/de_DE.js`
